info.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX6
info.author: openDJ (from the DDJ-FLX4 mapping by Robert904 and the DDJ-400 mapping)
info.description: openDJ mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-FLX6: four decks, four-channel mixer, pads that follow the screen. Beta: written from Pioneer's MIDI message list, not yet tried on the hardware.
